summary: GE-Proton's Wine through rach2-game under Xwayland on virgl, judged against the Debian guest in the same QEMU: a new prefix and the driver's video memory, GL and Direct3D 9 pixels at 64 and 32 bits, and the preloader's reserved ranges

cases.behavior: rach2-game makes a new prefix: wineboot -u exits 0, the prefix has drive_c/windows/syswow64 and no VideoMemorySize, and WineD3D's log in a 64-bit Direct3D 9 probe reports and emulates the video memory that glxinfo -B reads from GLX_MESA_query_renderer, as under Linux

execution.privileges: the runner runs as the desktop account, an ordinary user in the render group
execution.cleanup: the runner ends its Wine server and Weston, reaps them and removes its private prefix and shader cache on every exit; libetude-case stops QEMU and removes passed overlays, keeping failed overlays and the runner's logs

steps.does: boot an overlay of the GNU system's disk on virtio-blk with rach2.root=ext2 and the virgl display, log in as root and open the guest command channel
mount the probes' disk read-only and run the named row as the desktop account through the guest channel, under a headless Weston of its own on GL with Xwayland

assertions.checks: the launcher's prefix line, syswow64, the absent key and both WineD3D trace lines agree with glxinfo's video memory, and the runner prints GAMESROW OK prefix

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the row needs QEMU's virgl display and compares with the Debian guest in the same QEMU; the same guest runner made the Linux reference
